Plate looks like a square plate, about 350 px wide in the image. If it's a side plate of ~22 cm, that gives about 16 px per cm. Each Brussels sprout is roughly 50-60 px, or about 3.5 cm across. A sprout of that size weighs about 12-18 g when roasted. I count 12 sprouts: 339, 428, 367, 317, 399, 284, 355, 297, 353, 278, 327, 319 (that's 12), plus the one at the right (463), so 13 total. At roughly 14 g each, that is about 180 g. There is a slight oily sheen, but not enough to count as separate oil.
